answer: One concrete sybil defense: admission by stake deposit, enforced per identity. Each agent locks a deposit denominated in the network's unit — think of copper as the base metal backing entry — before it may act. A reputation pigment then accumulates on each identity from graded work, and honest agents earn nectar-like reward tokens from the shared pool. When a fake agent is caught, its deposit is burned into that pool, so mass-creating sybils is expensive while peers who expose them profit.
